scope: News startup and runtime storage recovery; partial Q08/R10 evidence. Q08 and Q10 retain broader acceptance scope.

decision.backend: Open the music shell before independent news recovery. Typed store faults close generation, scheduler and claim gates; retry is single-flight and stale attempts settle before replacement. Publish restored interrupted-request state only after durable write.
decision.cost: Healthy startup retains its due-now check. After a detected failure, explicit recovery durably pauses enabled preparation before ready. Existing Resume is the only preparation reauthorization.
decision.frontend: One app-level live notice and focus-preserving explicit Retry, with a non-live News explanation and readiness-gated controls. Preserve already-started speaking/paused audio and completed tail; release waiting claims.
decision.review: Boris reviewed actual backend changes and corrections; Elena reviewed actual renderer changes and paused-speech correction. Both reported no remaining actionable blocker in their reviewed scope.

verification.providers: Substituted text/speech, dummy locally encrypted keys, shared Keychain adapter disabled, non-local catalog/source network blocked. Actual Electron renderer/main/preload, disk, protocol, native music/speech decoding and OS encryption.
verification.storageFaults: Injected I/O failures at actual persistence boundaries, corrupt owned JSON, and actual chmod 000 prepared-audio read failure with mode restored in finally.
verification.visual: Inspected native recovery notice screenshot at supported baseline.

fixtureCorrections: Tracked real detached Audio objects through a constructor proxy rather than searching DOM audio elements.
Waited for initial navigation before fixture-only renderer reload.
Used actual Electron net.fetch for the registered media protocol because renderer fetch CSP intentionally blocks this route.
Paused-speech assertion follows the existing played-at-start delivery contract.

The isolated lifecycle harness explicitly seeds readiness because it does not run app startup; pause-write failure now asserts unavailable until explicit recovery. Native startup cases exercise the real initializer without this bypass.
limits: Controlled storage/provider failures and this Mac only; no live provider/billing, full VoiceOver, hardware matrix, audible-quality or observed-listener claim.

If storage refuses every write, a pause cannot be made durable. Until a successful recovery writes it, process-local failure state does not promise persistence through forced termination and later external repair. Healthy next-process startup honors its previously saved opt-ins.
One-second renderer status polling can leave a short visible delay; main gates close synchronously on detected failure.
A claim invalidated during disk commit is not returned and is released; if release itself cannot persist, successful reconciliation resets the stored claim before readiness.
This closes the reproduced startup defect and its scoped runtime paths, not every Q08 loading/error/empty branch or Q10 OS/display/hardware case. Inventory dispositions remain unchanged.
